purpose: Three costume tailoring alternatives, keeping source hairstyle, palette, pose, brush and scroll.

records.label: A 斜襟叠裁
records.prompt:
Create ONE COSTUME-CUT DESIGN VARIANT of the exact adult woman in the reference. STRICTLY LOCK her teal short bob, ivory forelock, hair silhouette, black/teal feather ornament and flower pin, face/eyes/expression, lowered three-quarter LEFT head direction, actual head/body proportions, body shape, stance, near-chin hand, opposite hand gripping the brush to screen-right, the whole brush design and position, giant ink-landscape scroll and both rollers, background/composition. No hairstyle, age, face, pose or color-scheme change.
Use the SAME charcoal-black, ivory, muted jade-teal and restrained antique-gold palette and similar overall color distribution. Only redesign CLOTHING TAILORING and a few connected garment ornaments: collar/shoulder, sleeve/cuff cut, waist closure, skirt panel shapes and teal fabric tails. Keep an elegant adult Chinese fantasy scholar and original fully opaque coverage level. No armor-heavy redesign, trousers replacing the entire dress, new props, extra limbs or additional jewelry clutter.
Project gem-icon art: strong controlled dark contour, clean substantial large color planes, 2–3 values per material, sparse details; no tiny triangular mosaic, noise, fine filigree or glossy realistic effects. Full single character on plain warm ivory square canvas with complete scroll, brush and both boots. No text or collage. COSTUME A — DIAGONAL WRAP / 斜襟叠裁. Replace the current decorative white chest bib with one broad clean ivory DIAGONAL CROSSOVER LAPEL flowing from neck across the torso to the side waist over black cloth. A small asymmetric black shoulder cape with a straight diagonal edge, no metal shoulder plate. Broad plain jade waist sash fastened OFF-CENTER with ONE rectangular antique-gold clasp. Sleeves have long angular folded ivory cuffs, one major fold each. Long black skirt constructed as THREE unequal overlapping diagonal panels, keeping the original leg opening and visible legs; an ivory triangular underlap shows between two panels. Teal trailing cloth becomes TWO broad long tapered tails with one narrow ivory edge, preserving its original sweep to the right. One oversized angular cloud-hook motif only near the lower black hem. Clean diagonal rhythms throughout, distinctly different garment construction from the source; original hair/colors/pose/scroll strictly retained.
